query:
-- Vue pour les synergies moléculaires avec noms des molécules
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW molecule_synergies_view AS
SELECT 
  ms.id,
  ms.molecule1_id,
  m1.name as molecule1_name,
  ms.molecule2_id,
  m2.name as molecule2_name,
  ms.type,
  ms.description,
  ms.chemical_mechanism,
  ms.applications,
  ms.createdAt
FROM molecule_synergies ms
JOIN molecules m1 ON m1.id = ms.molecule1_id
JOIN molecules m2 ON m2.id = ms.molecule2_id;
